jobs.title: Associate Director, Democracy and Politics
jobs.reason: IPPR is a leading progressive think-tank and the field (democracy, politics, policy research) is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but this is an Associate Director role leading a team of six, securing funding, and representing the organisation at the highest levels of government. Hard ineligibility on seniority — the role requires substantial leadership experience and a track record of influential policy delivery that an MSc candidate with student-assistant experience cannot meet.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales/account management role in the assurance sector, with no alignment to the candidate's IR, policy, or intelligence targets. It also requires fluency in a regionally-relevant business language (Mandarin/Cantonese for Shenzhen) which the candidate does not have, and 2+ years of sales experience the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales role in assurance/inspection services — pure sales is a field mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy/research focus. The role requires demonstrated sales track record and account management experience the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Food Safety Trainer - Contractor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a food safety/dairy technology training role requiring specialist qualifications (ISO 22000, FSSC, BRCGS lead auditor certification, food/dairy technology background) that the candidate does not hold. Hard ineligibility on specialist vocational qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer (Practice) in Primary Education (Mathematics)
jobs.reason: This is a senior teacher-training role requiring a qualified, experienced primary school teacher with specialist mathematics pedagogy expertise — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field. Hard ineligibility on seniority (Senior Lecturer level requiring substantial teaching experience) and on specialist vocational qualifications (primary teaching credentials).

jobs.title: Lecturer — Orthopaedic Surgery (Clinical Educator)
jobs.reason: This is a clinical medical educator role requiring an MBChB, HPCSA registration, and 4+ years post-community-service clinical experience in orthopaedic surgery. Hard ineligibility: the candidate has no medical qualification, no clinical practice licence, and lacks the required years of professional experience.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Digital Media
jobs.reason: Lecturer roles require a PhD or equivalent and an established track record of creative practice in digital media art (Unreal Engine, XR, AI image-making), none of which the candidate has. The field (digital media art practice) is also far from the candidate's IR/policy focus, and the seniority level is incompatible with an MSc-in-progress profile.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst, Technology and Geopolitics
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — geopolitical risk and tech/AI governance are core targets. However, this is a "Lead Analyst" role requiring established expertise in AI policy, quantum, and tech-geopolitics, with a track record of thought leadership and client deliverables. The candidate's MSc-in-progress and student-assistant experience are unlikely to meet the seniority bar for a Lead-level position with thematic specialism the CV does not yet demonstrate.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Human rights litigation is adjacent to the candidate's international law interests, but "Team Manager" at Reprieve's Project/Regional Lead pay band requires significant managerial and strategic litigation experience the candidate does not have. Likely also requires legal qualifications for overseeing litigation work.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Global Head of Sustainable Products & Packaging - Circularity & Value Chain Transformation
jobs.reason: This is a "Global Head" role in sustainability consulting focused on circular economy, packaging, and value chain transformation — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence target zones. The leadership title also requires extensive senior consulting experience the candidate does not have. Hard mismatch on both field and seniority.
